projects.name: AcmeCorp Phase 2 — Operating Model Redesign
projects.description: Multi-workstream engagement including operating model redesign, procurement deep-dive, and quick wins implementation. Phase 1 diagnostic identified $18M in savings. Phase 2 compressed to 10-week timeline with multiple workstreams and steering committee governance.

projects.name: LuxeGroup Digital Strategy
projects.description: Digital strategy roadmap for LuxeGroup focusing on employee experience, HR transformation, and technology enablement. EUR 2.5M budget over 18 months with 90-day quick wins requirement. Board presentation scheduled for January.

projects.name: Singtel Customer Experience Transformation
projects.description: 8-week diagnostic phase for Singtel covering customer journey mapping across 6 channels and benchmarking against regional telcos. Singapore-based team of 4 consultants. Proposal development in progress.

projects.name: IndustrieWerke Strategic Transformation
projects.description: Three-workstream proposal covering German market consolidation strategy (8 weeks), operational efficiency programme across 12 plants, and market entry strategy. Likely to start with Workstream 1 as proof of concept. In-person meeting in Stuttgart completed.

projects.name: Nippon Partners Strategic Alliance
projects.description: Exploration of strategic alliance between StrategyCo and Nippon Partners covering joint market study of APAC consulting landscape (Q1 2026), pilot engagement, and potential long-term partnership. Phased approach with Tokyo meeting planned for February.

projects.name: Q2 Pipeline and APAC Business Development
projects.description: Ongoing pipeline development across APAC region including Singtel (CX transformation), DBS Bank (cost optimisation lead), and other opportunities. Coordination between London and Singapore offices for regional growth.

terminology.Engagement: Client mandate or project, typically structured in multiple phases
terminology.Phase: Distinct stage of a client engagement with defined scope and timeline
terminology.Workstream: Sub-project or thematic track within an engagement
terminology.Steering committee: Client governance body overseeing engagement progress and decisions
terminology.Quick wins: Rapid, high-impact improvements identifiable early in diagnostic phase
terminology.Operating model: Organizational structure, processes, and systems defining how a company operates
terminology.Target-state strawman: Initial draft of proposed future-state operating model
terminology.Diagnostic: Initial assessment phase analyzing current-state operations
terminology.Current-state: Existing organizational structure, processes, and performance baseline
terminology.Deliverable: Formal output or document provided to client (deck, report, charter)
terminology.Workstream charter: Scoping document defining objectives, approach, and resources for a workstream
terminology.Context pack: Background materials and data provided to project team
terminology.BU head interviews: Stakeholder interviews with business unit leaders
terminology.Indirect cost allocation: Method of distributing overhead costs across business units
terminology.Actuals: Actual financial results or spending (vs. budget or forecast)
terminology.McKinsey 7S framework: Strategic analysis model covering Strategy, Structure, Systems, Skills, Style, Staff, Shared Values
terminology.Change management: Discipline managing organizational transition and stakeholder adoption
terminology.Change lead: Person responsible for change management workstream
terminology.RACI matrix: Responsibility assignment chart (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed)
terminology.Spans and layers: Analysis of management hierarchy depth and span of control
terminology.Value chain: Sequence of activities creating value from inputs to customer delivery
terminology.Revenue: On budget: Engagement financials tracking to planned revenue targets
terminology.Anchor too low: Pricing negotiation term — setting initial price point too conservatively
terminology.Proof of concept: Initial limited-scope engagement to demonstrate value before full commitment
terminology.Customer journey mapping: Analysis of end-to-end customer experience across touchpoints
terminology.Pipeline: Portfolio of prospective client engagements in various stages of development
terminology.Deal size: Expected revenue value of a client engagement

frequent_topics: APAC pipeline development and business development
